description: Coders Talk: step 1 of sending the current coding session to the user's Coders Talk drafts, for the Coders Talk skill or plugin only. Call it only after the user asked to send this session and agreed to what the skill's preview showed. Returns a one-time upload link (15 minutes) for the skill's upload step, and an upload_id for finish_session_upload. Never put anything else at the link.
name: start_session_upload
title: Start sending this session to Coders Talk
